title: v0.9.0 - The Cloud-Native Evolution & Drizzle Migration
description: A milestone release marking the transition to a robust, cloud-native architecture with Neon PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, and significant performance optimizations for the global deployment environment.

items.title: Neon & PostgreSQL Migration
items.description: Pegasus is now powered by Neon, providing a serverless, scalable PostgreSQL foundation.
details: Drizzle ORM Integration: Fully type-safe database layer with Drizzle for improved developer velocity and reliability.
PostgreSQL Standard: Transitioned from SurrealDB to standard PostgreSQL, enabling better tool support and SQL compliance.
Serverless Scaling: Leveraging Neon's autoscaling and branching for high-performance data operations.
Unified Schema: Consolidated architecture around a single, robust Drizzle schema definition.

items.title: Universal AI Search Infrastructure
items.description: Real-time web intelligence integrated directly into the AI reasoning loop.
details: Multi-Provider Support: Seamlessly switch between Tavily, You.com, and Serper.dev for high-quality web research.
Direct Web Research: AI can now proactively search the internet for market trends, competitors, and general knowledge.
Automatic Fallback: Intelligent search engine picks the best available provider based on your configuration.
Real-time Grounding: Combine outside information with your local data for a complete 360-degree analysis.

items.title: Experimental Features System
items.description: Fine-grained control over the next generation of Pegasus tools.
details: RAG Pipeline: Early access to Retrieval-Augmented Generation for AI grounded in your private data.
Real-time API Tools: Toggle AI's ability to call external APIs for live stock, weather, and custom data.
Feature Gating: Enterprise-grade control over which beta features are available to users.
Direct Request Flow: Request access to experimental features directly from the user settings.

items.title: Favorites System
items.description: Keep your most important work within reach.
details: Dashboard Bookmarks: Save dashboards to your personal favorites list for instant access from the sidebar.
Data Space Pins: Mark frequently used data spaces as favorites to streamline your workflow.
Persistent State: Favorites are synced across devices and sessions.

items.title: Context-Aware AI Reasoning
items.description: Smarter context discovery for better research results.
details: Contextual Search Scoping: AI automatically identifies your industry domain (e.g., fashion, tech) to narrow web searches.
Search Query Refinement: Sophisticated prompt rules ensure the AI uses high-quality market research keywords.
Relevance Filtering: Automatically discards search results that don't match the industry context of your private data.

items.title: Enhanced AI Response Rendering
items.description: Beautiful, structured chat interface for complex AI responses.
details: Structured Data Parsing: Resolved issues with raw JSON blocks appearing in the chat; responses are now elegantly formatted.
Clean Tool Iteration: Smoother UI transitions when the AI iterates through multiple data and search steps.

items.title: Backend Startup Optimization
items.description: Significant reliability improvements for cloud deployments.
details: Zero-Wait Port Binding: Resolved 502 Bad Gateway errors by prioritizing HTTP server startup.
Async Initialization: Services and database checks now initialize in the background without blocking connectivity.
Explicit 0.0.0.0 Binding: Guaranteed accessibility across global edge environments and container platforms.
Boot Time Logging: Enhanced observability for the entire backend boot sequence.

items.title: Explorer Bulk Actions
details: Multi-select Selection: Shift/Ctrl click to select multiple items in the Data Explorer.
Batch Deletion: Remove multiple files or dashboards in a single operation.
Resource Cleanup: Improved background cleanup for deleted assets and temporary files.

items.title: Local Storage Strategy
items.description: Standardized handling of local assets and development data.
details: Dedicated local/ Directory: Unified folder for untracked files, scripts, and local data stores.
Enhanced .gitignore: Robust rules to prevent sensitive local data from leaking into the repository.
DuckDB Analytics: Strategic use of local DuckDB for high-speed analytical workloads before cloud sync.

items.title: Hybrid Storage Manager
details: S3 & GCP Compatibility: Seamlessly switch between AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, and local disks.
Provider Factory: Dynamic resolution of storage backends based on deployment environment and user configuration.
Presigned URL Support: Secure, direct-to-cloud file access for improved performance and security.

items.title: Token & Usage Tracking
items.description: Precise monitoring of AI resources and quotas.
details: Token Audit Log: Detailed tracking of every AI interaction for accurate consumption metrics.
Dynamic Quotas: Real-time enforcement of storage and token limits based on subscription tiers.
Billing Integration: Foundation for usage-based billing and credit top-ups.
